name: Fallen Seeds
source:
"Fallen Seeds" is a sci-fi visual novel with datе sim elements that follows the adventures of Evod, a special agent of the Earth Empire, during his mission on the enigmatic planet of Ulthar, inhabited by zoomorphic extraterrestrial beings known as Chimy.

Players will join Evod as he embarks on his mission and discovers that the vibrant resort planet has a darker side. The planet harbors an Anomalous Zone, a mysterious and perilous area that becomes the subject of numerous investigations and the intersection of powerful Galactic forces' interests. Amidst a complex web of political intrigue, players must decide who to befriend and who will stand as their adversary. They will navigate what Evod is willing to sacrifice on his quest for truth and whether he is prepared to confront his long-forgotten past.

The game has multiple roots and endings and features five heroines, with the possibility of developing romantic relationships with one of them.
translation:
《堕落的种子》是一部带有约会元素的科幻视觉小说，讲述了地球帝国特工埃沃德在神秘的乌撒星球执行任务期间的冒险经历，该星球居住着被称为奇米的动物外星生物。

玩家将与Evod一起执行任务，并发现充满活力的度假星球也有黑暗的一面。这颗行星上有一个异常区，这是一个神秘而危险的区域，成为众多调查的对象和强大银河势力利益的交汇点。在复杂的政治阴谋网络中，玩家必须决定与谁交朋友以及谁将成为他们的对手。他们将了解埃沃德在追求真理的过程中愿意牺牲什么，以及他是否准备好面对他早已被遗忘的过去。

该游戏有多个根源和结局，有五位女主角，有可能与其中一位发展浪漫关系。
